newsitem.title: UK: Pilkington shares down after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Pilkington shares down after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Pilkington Plc fell on Tuesday after the British glass maker said profits for the year to end-March 1997 would be below market expectations.
By 0829 GMT the shares were down 11-1/2p at 117, their lowest level since July 1993.
Pilkington said profits for the year to end-March would be not less than 130 million stg. It blamed market conditions in Europe, particularly Germany, for the lower-than-expected earnings.
One dealer said the news was disappointing but Pilkington's fortunes could only improve.
"We are at the bottom of the trough," he said. "It is just a question of time before we kick off the bottom. Things can only get better from here."
